mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_tasks (id, user_id, title, session_id, pinned, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{sessionId}, #{pinned}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, session_id, pinned, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM chat_tasks WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, user_id, title, session_id, pinned, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM chat_tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY pinned DESC, updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_tasks SET title = #{title}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE chat_tasks SET pinned = #{pinned}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE chat_tasks SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE chat_tasks SET deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
